tools.name: deploy_service
tools.description:
Deploys a service to the selected environment.

IMPORTANT: Always confirm the target environment with the user before deploying to production.
IMPORTANT: Do not deploy when the test suite is failing.

NOTE: Deployments are asynchronous. Poll `get_deployment_status` until the state is `ready` or `failed`.
WARNING: Rolling back removes the newest release; this cannot be undone.

See https://docs.example.com/deploy for details, and https://status.example.com for incidents.

Examples:
  deploy_service(service="api", env="staging")
  deploy_service(service="web", env="production", wait=true)

service.description: Service name as shown in the dashboard

tools.name: get_deployment_status
tools.description: Returns the state of the latest deployment. IMPORTANT: results can be cached for up to 30 seconds.
